_what: A VENUE — a hall's numbers for each microphone (PLAN 1.4 · 11.7; RUNNING_LOG §165). Copy this file to bank/venue/<name>.json and name it in bank/elec_route.json "venue" (or  node tools/elec.js start --venue <name> ). trimDb: the microphone's trim inside the engine — WRITTEN BY THE CALIBRATION (node tools/elec.js calibrate --venue <name>: each player plays one mf on cue; the trim puts that reading on the ladder's mf, so that 'as played' means what the player meant). hpfHz: a high-pass on the microphone, 0 = off — THE AI'S START, by each instrument's lowest note: bass flute and viola 90, bass clarinet and cello 50, the percussion 40. eq: up to two corrective bands { hz, db, q } — a hall's boom, a microphone's edge; empty until an ear asks. A player not named is flat. The simulation uses no venue.
